about_module.textarea__title: We are Kingsbox. One of the largest providers of sports equipment in Europe.
about_module.wysiwyg__left_col_text: We are a Slovenian manufacturer of strength and conditioning equipment for gyms, studios, home gyms, and outdoor spaces. We create durable, modular solutions built for real training.
about_module.wysiwyg__right_col_text: We are more than an equipment supplier. We help build practical training spaces that perform better and make the most of every square meter.

about_module.textarea__title: Giving people a playground to develop into the best version of themselves.
about_module.wysiwyg__left_col_text: Ljudem dajemo igrišče z željo, da se razvijejo v najboljšo različico sebe. Trgu predstavljamo izdelke, ki navdušujejo množice v fitnes industriji.
about_module.wysiwyg__right_col_text: Svet, v katerem lahko vsakdo doseže svoj potencial.
